**Acceptance Criteria**

REQ-01 is mostly satisfied: `index.json` `schema_version` is documented and centralized through `SUPPORTED_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION`. REQ-03 is covered for equal/older versions. REQ-02 is still incomplete because `jit init` bypasses the startup compatibility guard when run inside an already initialized newer-format repository.

**Architecture And Separation**

The compatibility check remains in storage and top-level startup orchestration. No domain I/O or command/CLI parsing leakage found.

**Functional Paradigm**

No blocking functional-style issues found in the changed production code.

**Correctness And Invariants**

Atomic writes, event logging, gate transition semantics, assignee/label formats, PID safety, and unsafe-code policy are not materially changed. The repository-format invariant still has a startup bypass.

**Testing**

Provided `cargo-ci` evidence passed at `2026-07-05T07:13:45Z`; I did not rerun cargo tests. `./scripts/jit-validate.sh` passes locally. New CLI coverage exercises `status` and `gate list`, but not the remaining `init` bypass.

**Error Handling**

`RepositoryFormatTooNewError` is typed, contextual, single-line, and mapped to exit code 10.

**CLI Contract**

No new CLI command surface was added.

**Documentation**

The storage-format documentation says every command that opens the repository checks the format marker, but `init` does not do so for an existing repository.

**Jit Issue Management**

`issue.dependencies` is empty. Prior review feedback for `gate list`/non-index startup paths is mostly addressed, but not for all ways the binary can operate on an existing repository.

**Findings**

1. Blocking: `jit init` can still operate on an already initialized repository whose `.jit/index.json` has a newer `schema_version`, so REQ-02’s fail-fast guarantee is incomplete. The top-level startup guard only calls `storage.validate()` in the non-init branch ([main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1212), [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1271)); the compatibility check lives inside `validate()` ([json.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:131)). For `Commands::Init`, `executor.init()` calls `storage.init()` ([mod.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:897)), and `storage.init()` skips reading the existing index when it already exists ([json.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:467)). The init path then may continue with repository writes such as project config/rules scaffolding ([main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1248), [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1254)). The new CLI tests cover `status` and `gate list` only ([format_compat_cli_tests.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/format_compat_cli_tests.rs:56)), so this bypass is untested.
